{{Quote|This way we kill two dune lizards with one throw!|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>}}
The '''dune lizard''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]] found on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Dune lizards formed in packs, and their [[Stomach/Legends|gizzard]] could be consumed as [[Foodstuff/Legends|sustenance]]. A [[Chef/Legends|chef]] by the name of [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] acquired dune lizard gizzards to prepare as an appetizer for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]]. They were known to be aggressive towards [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]], at one point having eaten an [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Biology and appearance==
{{Quote|You're going to start by bringing me gizzards. Gizzards from lizards. Dune lizards to be exact. Dune lizard gizzards. Hey, that's fun to say!|[[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:JPP">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Jabba's Palace : Porcellus|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
Dune lizards were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Lizard/Legends|lizards]] native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], a [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Limb/Legends|quadrupedal]] [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]]<ref name="SWG" /> were known to spook [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]],<ref name="EopieDefender">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Eopie Defender}}</ref> and they also exhibited aggressive tendencies towards [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]].<ref name="SWG:PJ">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Pfilbee Jhorn|Tatooine}}</ref> Dune lizards were [[vertebrate]]s with scaly skin, typically in subdued palettes of [[Color/Legends|brown]],<ref name="SWG" /> though when held in captivity as pets, their skin could come in a variety of hues, including shades of red, yellow and blue.<ref name="SWG:C6">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref> Dune lizards had yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], a long tail, and frills protruding from their back. A group of dune lizards was referred to as a pack. When vocalizing, dune lizards would emanate a hissing growl.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
{{Quote|Dune lizards. Hate 'em. They think this is their territory. One Imperial officer gets eaten, and suddenly it's my problem. Now it's yours. Kill 'em&mdash;the lizards, not the troops. Don't have any credits left in the budget, but maybe I can work out some other payoff.|[[Pfilbee Jhorn]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:PJ" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], Imperial [[Janitor/Legends|Custodial Officer]] [[Pfilbee Jhorn]] oversaw a number of pest control measures from his post in [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Tatooine. When an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] ended up getting eaten by dune lizards, Jhorn sought to contract the services of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to eliminate all of the lizards encroaching upon their territory.<ref name="SWG:PJ" /> Meanwhile, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] by the name of [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] worked at the behest of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]]. During his time at [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], Porcellus planned to use stuffed dune lizard [[Stomach/Legends|gizzards]] as an appetizer for one of Jabba's meals.<ref name="SWG:JPP" /> On the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], the Galactic Empire operated a top-secret research facility known as the [[The Warren (Dantooine)|Warren]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The facility was commanded by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Bors Teraud]] along with the help of a loyal [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] named [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Knag]]. Together, the duo conducted [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] research on a number of different species, including dune lizards.<ref name="SWG:TW">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|The Warren|Dantooine}}</ref>

Dune lizards were also associated with the idiom, to "kill two dune lizards with one throw." The Rebel Alliance [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|hero]] and Tatooine native [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] mentioned this saying to his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], while en route to the planet [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]].<ref name="TLC" /> A [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] developed by [[MandalMotors/Legends|MandalMotors]] known as the [[G1-M4-C Dunelizard fighter]] was named after the dune lizard.<ref name="JTL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Dune lizards appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Dune lizards in the game were almost identical to [[Scyk/Legends|scyks]], [[dragonet]]s and [[Rill (species)|rills]], as all these creatures used the same model with different textures.<ref name="SWG" />
